verified_facts.text: The hotel displays a curated collection of artifacts and antique books, honouring its heritage as a beacon of education.

verified_facts.text: The Spice Bazaar, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Karaköy are within walking distance.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is minutes from Galataport Istanbul and its international cruise terminal.
